description: Production AKS baseline with Azure CNI overlay, Azure AD workload identity, ingress via Application Gateway, cluster autoscaler, pod security standards, and GitOps-driven deployments from a private container registry.
constraints: No cluster admin kubeconfig shared outside break-glass
Images pulled only from approved private registry
Network policies default deny between namespaces
Node pools segregated by workload sensitivity
assumptions: Three node pools: system, general workloads, sensitive workloads
Platform team owns cluster; app teams own namespaces
